Title: Customer-managed keys for Azure Container Registry now generally available

Body.Content:
Managed keys for Azure Container Registry are now available for new registries. Use this capability to bring your own encryption key for Azure Container Registry. By using your own key stored in an Azure Key Vault to encrypt your images and artifacts, you’ll be better able to adhere to internal compliance regulations.

Learn more
